outcome: Successful vaginal birth after cesarean delivery
Repeat cesarean section for arrest of descent
cohort: 179 women with a previous cesarean section for arrest of descent
finding: Women who had a higher newborn weight in the current pregnancy compared to their previous pregnancy were less likely to have a successful vaginal birth after cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Women who had a higher newborn weight in the current pregnancy compared to their previous pregnancy were less likely to have a successful vaginal birth after cesarean delivery.
